purpose: Prevent duplicate issue builds while active repair PRs are tested or queued, until linked-PR selection is deployed.

holds.limits: Accepted normal CLI pause receipt; no native retirement or released capacity inferred.

release_condition: Reassess only if the corresponding PR is closed unmerged and work must return to the issue lane; merged PRs close their source issue. Do not resume an issue into a duplicate build while its PR remains active.
limits: Normal authenticated CLI admission/pause only; no direct database mutations.
Source-only holds do not confer PR execution or merge approval.
Native retirement and resource credit are not inferred from pause acceptance.
